description: Curated public website references and tools, separate from GitHub repositories and autonomous integration eligibility.

resources.name: Scrolltide
bestFor: Cinematic scroll-driven landing pages
3D web templates and prompt-guided UI prototypes
avoidWhen: A fully free reusable asset is required
Redistributing paid source, prompts or preview media
resources.licenseNote: Commercial prompt/template subscriptions; review the item terms before reusing source or assets.

resources.name: Awwwards
bestFor: Researching award-winning websites and visual directions
Finding interaction and layout inspiration
avoidWhen: Looking for redistributable source code or ready-to-install libraries
resources.licenseNote: Showcased websites belong to their respective creators; listing is not a code or asset license.

resources.name: Recent (formerly Godly)
bestFor: Curated web, interface and motion design references
Exploring visual styles before implementation
avoidWhen: Assuming examples have reusable source code or assets
resources.licenseNote: Former Godly URL now redirects to Recent; each showcased design retains its own rights.

resources.name: 60fps
bestFor: Studying polished app micro-interactions and motion timing
Designing native/mobile or web UI transitions
avoidWhen: Using reference recordings or interface assets as redistributable code
resources.licenseNote: Animation showcases are reference material; do not assume source, brand assets or recordings are licensed for reuse.

resources.name: 21st.dev
bestFor: Finding React/Tailwind interface components and landing-page blocks
Prototyping shadcn-compatible frontend experiences
avoidWhen: Using in non-React projects without a port
Installing components without checking their author-specific license and dependencies
resources.licenseNote: Community component registry; inspect the specific component's license, author and dependencies before inclusion.

resources.name: Aceternity UI
bestFor: Animated React/Next.js components and visual backgrounds
High-impact hero sections and motion UI
avoidWhen: Redistributing components or templates as marketplace assets
Ignoring component-specific or Pro licensing terms
resources.licenseNote: Pro items use the Aceternity License; review item-specific terms and third-party licenses before copying code.

resources.name: Magic UI
bestFor: Animated React interface components and polished landing pages
Micro-interactions and visually distinctive UI
avoidWhen: Assuming premium templates are freely reusable
Installing without verifying the exact item's license
resources.licenseNote: Free and premium offerings differ; verify the selected component's licensing and dependencies.

resources.name: Three.js
bestFor: Building interactive browser 3D scenes with Three.js
Consulting 3D rendering documentation and examples
avoidWhen: Treating the entire Three.js engine as a missing dependency in unrelated applications
Copying third-party example assets without checking their licenses
resources.licenseNote: The Three.js library is MIT-licensed (mrdoob/three.js); third-party models, textures and example assets may carry separate terms.

resources.name: Shadertoy
bestFor: Exploring real-time GLSL shader techniques and visual effects
Experimenting with procedural GPU graphics
avoidWhen: Copying community shaders without permission or author attribution
Assuming demo GLSL ports directly to another rendering engine
resources.licenseNote: User-published shader code is not automatically covered by one blanket redistribution license; verify each author's terms.

resources.name: Lovable
bestFor: Generating and iterating on web-app prototypes from prompts
Building frontend proof-of-concepts without manual scaffolding
avoidWhen: Assuming its free credit allocation is unlimited
Treating a hosted builder as an open-source runtime dependency
resources.licenseNote: Hosted AI app builder with usage-limited free plan and paid options; generated code and third-party assets require normal review.
